events.name: Music Award Winner
events.description: You on a giant music-awards stage at the microphone, holding a gold record trophy, then lifting it high as two confetti cannons fire and gold confetti rains down over you (or the two of you, winning it together).

events.name: Middle Finger Dunk
events.description: On a packed park court at night you cross your friend over, fly over them in slow motion, slam it one-handed, then walk up to the camera and brush off your shoulders while they laugh behind you.

events.name: Puerto Rican Mami Dance
events.description: Two friends at night under a white canopy, filmed from a phone on the ground: arms up and wide, a bump, a knee slap, a quick swap of sides, then a lean down at the lens. Just you, or you and a friend.

events.name: Sunset Squad Dance
events.description: Your squad on a seaside boardwalk at golden hour: pets up on their hind legs in black sunglasses, friends beside them, one taking the paws-on-head bob, one the double thumbs-up, then everyone bouncing at the lens and freestyling in a row.

events.name: Uptown Funk Dance
events.description: In a cream retro suit with wide lapels, you strut down a sunny brown-brick street toward the camera, pop your shoulders, snap, point at the lens and tug your lapels straight. Or bring a friend or two in mustard and burgundy, or your cat or dog in a little suit jacket.
